items: 【Powerful Suction for Any Messes】UML0 S3P cordless vacuum cleaner is equipped with a 300W brushless motor that delivers 45kPa strong suction, effectively removing embedded debris, pet hair, and cat litter from hard floors and low-pile carpets. Brushless cordless vacuum is long-lasting and more energy efficient, compared with regular brushed stick vacuum

【Up to 55-Min Long Battery Life】Equipped with a 6-cell high-capacity rechargeable battery, this stick vacuum cordless rechargeable provides up to 55 minutes of uninterrupted cleaning (55 mins in Eco Mode, 25 mins in Strong Mode), ideal for large areas or multiple rooms. The detachable battery of the rechargeable vacuum cordless can be charged separately or on its main body (always use the original adapter for charging)

【All-in-One LED Display】The intelligent LED display of this cordless stick vacuum provides clear visibility of the battery status and suction mode, which helps you monitor the status of the stick vacuum cleaner cordless better, check the battery power in real time, empowering you to stay in control at all times

【Upgraded Tangle-Free LED Flexible Brush Head】The S3P vacuum cleaners for home pet hair feature a V-shaped anti-tangle roller that lifts embedded dirt and pet hair from carpets and floors while reducing hair entanglement. The brush head rotates 90° vertically and 165° horizontally, easily reaching under furniture and beds. With 4 built-in bright LED lights, it exposes hidden dust and hair, making it perfect for homes with pets

【6-Stage High-Efficiency Filtration】This cordless stick vacuum cleaner features the latest 6-stage fully-sealed filtration system and captures 99.99% of ultra-fine dust and locks in small particles without leakage to release cleaner air for your family. The cordless vacuum cleaner pet hair with a large capacity dust cup, easily emptied with the push of a button. For optimal performance, the HEPA filter should be cleaned every 2-3 weeks and replaced every 3 months

【Free-Standing & Versatile & Lightweight】Featuring a user-friendly free-standing design, the cordless vacuum cleaners for home stand upright anywhere. Equipped with a 2-in-1 dusting brush and crevice tool, it effortlessly converts to a handheld vacuum, reaching hard-to-access areas like ceilings, car seats, RV corners, and under furniture. Our cordless vacuum has a lightweight design, and it’s lightweight enough for seniors and kids to use easily

【Peace of Mind with 2-Year Warranty】Your satisfaction is our top priority. That's why we offer a 2-year warranty, standing by the quality of our product. If you need assistance, we're here to help. Invest in a stick vacuum cordless that not only cleans like a champ but also offers unwavering support
